verdict.rationale: The RX 9070 XT's software stack (ROCm) is clearly versioned: ROCm 7.2.1 is listed for RDNA 4, there is a compatibility matrix tied to a specific ROCm release, and a transition guide covers moving off the legacy release stream. No evidence shows a documented deprecation policy, so only the versioning half of the story is supported. Missing for 10: a documented API deprecation policy with timelines, API-level versioning and stability guarantees, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: ROCm™ 7.2.1 supports the latest Radeon™ 9000 Series (RDNA™ 4) and select 7000 Series (RDNA™ 3) GPUs
To plan your ROCm 10.0.0 installation, use the following selector to view ROCm compatibility and system requirements information for your AMD hardware configuration
The transition from the legacy ROCm release stream began with ROCm Core SDK 7.14.0, the first production release.
